categories.main_business_segments: Qing Song Health Co., Ltd. primarily operates in long-term care services including community-based, home-based, and residential care services. The company also engages in real estate leasing, care supplies sales, and interior design and renovation services. Its long-term care services cover 24-hour residential care, daytime care centers, group homes, and small multifunctional services, targeting elderly and disabled populations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on service provision rather than manufacturing, emphasizing digital transformation and smart care technologies such as AI applications, IoT, and health monitoring platforms to enhance care quality and operational efficiency. It develops and optimizes its own ERP system (QERP2.0) to reduce paper use and streamline processes, integrating wearable and medical devices for personalized health management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Qing Song serves elderly individuals requiring long-term care, including those with disabilities and dementia, primarily in Taiwan. Its customers include individuals and families seeking residential, community, or home care services. The company also provides consulting services for private schools transitioning to long-term care institutions and targets the growing silver-haired and aging population.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with a strong presence in central Taiwan (Taichung, Nantou, Changhua), and expanding into northern and southern metropolitan areas including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. It covers 22 administrative regions nationwide, with plans to further expand into six major cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qing Song operates primarily downstream in the long-term care service supply chain, directly providing care services to end users. It also manages upstream activities such as facility development, interior design, and procurement of care supplies, but its core role is as a service provider in the healthcare and elderly care ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital transformation, integrating AI and smart care technologies to improve care efficiency and quality. It focuses on expanding service capacity, developing all-age friendly housing, and promoting self-paid services alongside government-subsidized care. Qing Song also emphasizes talent cultivation through academic partnerships and professional training to address labor shortages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from fees for long-term care services including residential, community, and home care. Additional income comes from real estate leasing, interior design and renovation services, and sales of care-related consumables. The company also explores consulting services and self-paid care service platforms to diversify income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qing Song is a leading long-term care operator in central Taiwan with a significant market share in residential and community care services. It differentiates itself through a chain-operated business model, extensive geographic coverage, and integration of government long-term care policies. Competitors include other private and public long-term care providers, but Qing Song's scale, brand, and innovation provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Qing Song reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$982.6 million, a 13% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$40.7 million. The company has steadily expanded its service points and workforce, with over 1,100 employees and more than 1,000 licensed residential care beds. Despite a slight decline in net profit margin due to increased operating expenses and listing-related costs, the company maintains a positive growth trajectory and solid financial structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qing Song emphasizes comprehensive, continuous, and multi-level long-term care services under a unified brand, offering 24-hour residential care, community day care, and personalized home care. Its integration of smart care technologies and digital platforms enhances service quality and operational efficiency. The company’s professional training system and academic collaborations ensure high-quality care personnel, while its chain operation model and geographic coverage provide convenience and reliability to customers.
